tasks.short: Keep loan records without a score.

steps.what: List stored loan records with no credit score
Process and maintain records of customer loans
Decide the loan record without a credit score
Sign the loan record
File the signed loan record
outputs: filed copy of signed loan record v1

tasks.design: A job lists stored loan records in {BANK} and writes no credit score. The teller processes and maintains the records and decides what the record says. A later job files the signed record in {DOCS}. It does not decide creditworthiness.
tasks.previous_blocker: Loan rows were recopied into the record.
tasks.enabler_now: Loan identifier, balance, and status are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The record is still the teller's judgement.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week on the record, not on listing the loans.

reach.task: Use only the record the teller signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a person keeps persuading and the payment release.
Digest [S17] says worker monitoring and creditworthiness of natural persons are high-risk. This design does not score a customer.

assumptions: Loan identifier, balance, and status are stored on the loan record. The loan record produces them. A blank balance stays blank and is not treated as zero. The list is not a credit score.
Native configuration of the loan record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining work is still the teller maintaining the loan records.

incremental.description: Refresh loan identifier, balance, and status when the loan layout changes, and drop a record the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many loan balances are blank. The high end assumes loan identifier, balance, and status are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read daily international rate sheets
Quote unit exchange rates from that sheet
Follow computer displays when the sheet is blank
Sign the rate quote
File the signed rate quote
outputs: filed copy of signed rate quote v1

tasks.design: A job reads the daily international rate sheets in {BANK}. The teller quotes the unit exchange rates and follows the computer displays when the sheet is blank. A later job files the signed quote in {DOCS}. A blank rate is not quoted as zero.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rates were copied from a paper sheet.
tasks.enabler_now: Currency pair and rate are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The teller still speaks the quote.
tasks.human_edge: The teller decides which rate to quote.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week on the quote, not on reading the sheet.

reach.task: Hear only the rate the teller quoted

evidence.claim: The executive digest says most of these figures are arithmetic on records, and interest charges are configuration or plain code.
The executive digest says a person keeps persuading and the payment release.

assumptions: Currency pair, rate, and rate date are stored on the rate record. The rate record produces them. A blank rate stays blank and is not quoted as zero.
Native configuration of the rate record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining quote is still the teller quoting the exchange rates.

incremental.description: Refresh currency pair and rate when the rate layout changes, and drop a quote the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many rates are blank. The high end assumes currency pair and rate are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Issue bond checks after a signature.

steps.what: List the stored settlement amount for the bond
Decide the settlement of the transactions
Check the amount owed to the bond owners
Sign the bond settlement check
Issue only the signed checks to bond owners
outputs: filed copy of signed bond check v1

tasks.design: A job lists the stored settlement amount in {BANK}. The teller decides the settlement and checks the amount owed to the bond owners. A later job issues only the signed checks. It does not issue an unsigned check.
tasks.previous_blocker: The settlement amount was retyped onto the check.
tasks.enabler_now: Bond identifier and settlement amount are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The teller still checks the owner and the amount.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week on the settlement, not on listing the amount.

reach.task: Take only the check the teller signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a person keeps persuading and the payment release.
The executive digest says most of these figures are arithmetic on records, and interest charges are configuration or plain code.

assumptions: Bond identifier, owner identifier, and settlement amount are stored on the payment record. The payment record produces them. A blank amount stays blank and is not issued.
Native configuration of the payment record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
The issue is the signed amount and no other check.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining decision is still the teller deciding the settlement.

incremental.description: Refresh bond identifier and settlement amount when the payment layout changes, and drop a check the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many settlement amounts are blank. The high end assumes bond identifier and settlement amount are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Compute the currency exchange fee from the stored rule
Inform customers about foreign currency regulations
Check the transaction fees for currency exchanges
Sign the exchange explanation
File the signed exchange explanation
outputs: filed copy of signed exchange explanation v1

tasks.design: A job in {ERP} computes the currency exchange fee from the stored rule. The teller informs customers about foreign currency regulations and checks the transaction fees. A later job files the signed explanation in {DOCS}. A blank rate is not computed as zero, and the job does not quote a rule it does not store.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fees were recomputed while the customer waited.
tasks.enabler_now: Currency pair, rate, and fee code are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The explanation stays with the teller.
tasks.human_edge: The teller decides what the regulation requires.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week on the explanation, not on the arithmetic.

reach.task: Hear only the fee the teller checked

evidence.claim: The executive digest says most of these figures are arithmetic on records, and interest charges are configuration or plain code.
The executive digest says a person keeps persuading and the payment release.

assumptions: Currency pair, rate, fee code, and base amount are stored on the fee record. The fee record produces them. A blank rate stays blank and is not computed as zero.
Native configuration of the fee record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining talk is still the teller informing customers about the regulations.

incremental.description: Refresh currency pair, rate, and fee code when the fee layout changes, and drop an explanation the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many fee rates are blank. The high end assumes currency pair, rate, and fee code are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The teller spends the week at the window, on the cash, and on the signed amount. A stored total, a fee from a stored rule, and filing that signature can move. The teller still counts the cash, checks the signature, and releases the payment.
reach: A customer receives only the amount the teller signed.
A colleague posts only the deposit the teller signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a payout that the teller has not signed.
Reject a fee that does not match the stored rule.
Reject a balance that treats a blank amount as zero.
role.ambitious_version: A signed payout or statement can go out the same day, and the teller still owns the cash.
